title: MOOR Software Manufacturing Machine
page0: Turn the MOOR software machine into an explorable fake 3D physical machine without allowing the physical metaphor to become fake logic. Bring the practical benefits of manufacturing—routing, work cells, fixtures, bills of material, serial travelers, quality control, maintenance, line stops, rework, change control and visible plant state—to software manufacturing, while making the process as accessible as possible.
correctedQuestion: How should MOOR become a spatial software factory whose 3D machine makes invisible software production legible and operable, while every depicted machine state remains traceable to real executable logic, evidence and authority?
thesis: The software system is the machine; the 3D environment is its truthful factory floor, control surface and maintenance projection. Spatial metaphor may simplify understanding, never fabricate capability.
laws: Source of truth remains executable software, machine-readable state and verified receipts; 3D is a projection/control plane.
Every authoritative 3D machine part must map to a stable software subsystem ID and evidence.
No green/healthy visual state without an automated or explicit verification record.
Documented-but-unexercised, inherited/shared, candidate, degraded and missing states are visually distinct.
A work order preserves immutable Page 0 intent before routing.
Bills of material are versioned blueprints/packages/references with provenance.
Work cells receive scoped capability and bounded resource/WIP budgets.
Receipts are serial travelers: they bind work order, route, inputs, output, authority state and ledger head.
QC is independent verification; production authorization cannot be inferred from builder confidence.
Failures create durable rework evidence instead of being hidden by a successful-looking scene.
Engineering change control separates candidate law from active law and requires regression plus explicit promotion.
Maintenance status is a first-class product surface, not an after-the-fact document.
The default human view is simple enough to understand in seconds; detail is available by inspection instead of permanent clutter.

manufacturingMap.benefit: The requested outcome cannot silently drift during production.
Inputs and dependencies are explicit and reusable.
Repeatable assembly without re-solving known structure.
Visible legal movement through the process.
Complexity is bounded instead of silently exploding.
Every authority-bearing result has traceable lineage.
Build success and intent match are separately proven.
Humans can see blocked, degraded, candidate and healthy systems immediately.
Bad output becomes learning input rather than disappearing.
Core law cannot drift because one agent edited it.
Complex process becomes spatially inspectable without replacing the underlying machine.

truthModel.target: 100% traceability of claimed behavior and displayed state
truthModel.nonClaim: Not a claim of mathematically perfect, bug-free software.
truthModel.visualRule: Decoration may be arbitrary; authoritative glyphs, routes and status colors must derive from machine-readable state.

accessibility.defaultView: Walk into one clean factory floor and see active law, candidate law, major work cells, line health and current bottlenecks.
accessibility.progressiveDisclosure: Selecting a machine reveals purpose, software owner, live-path status, evidence, receipts and maintenance notes.
accessibility.noviceRule: A person should not need repository knowledge to distinguish working, candidate, inherited/shared, failed and missing.
accessibility.expertRule: Every displayed subsystem exposes exact file/test/receipt references.

acceptance: Pulse Beam remains the live Pulse shell and future dashboard rebuilds preserve it.
The 3D Citadel loads a machine-readable maintenance state rather than inferring health from decoration.
Every authoritative maintenance glyph maps to a software subsystem and evidence.
Known gaps remain visible and cannot render as healthy.
A maintenance sweep reports multiple core subsystem tests even when one unrelated UI regression fails.
The factory metaphor is documented as projection/control plane, never source of truth.
Grounded Readiness and other future laws can be represented as work standards without bypassing authority/promotion.
